observations: Separate outlines for 8 (mock-Tudor), 15-17, 11-13 and the 19-21 Anchor Street corner. Read in the site frame by georeferencing the screenshot from its URL centre and 5m scale bar.

sources.author: Google satellite imagery
observations: Red tiled mock-Tudor roof directly after the NatWest parapet, low flat rooflit range behind it, slate roofs further south.

sources.author: Google Street View
observations: Mock-Tudor building adjoins NatWest with no gap; William Hill follows. Eaves heights judged against the NatWest cornice.

sources.author: Google Maps contributor imagery
observations: Brick opticians frontage with pitched dormered roof, adjoining pale KBA frontage with paired gables. See August 2024 coverage and roof orbit in block-review.
Merges the run south of the mock-Tudor into one block (site y -54.6 to -79.7); used only to confirm the overall extent.

sources.author: Google Street View
observations: Myers: four front upper sashes, brick parapet, central three-light dormer, black opticians fascia and glass entrance. Private capture output/myers-front.png.

sources.author: Google Street View
observations: KBA: paired canted bays with decorative gables, 1989 plaque, Yorkshire and KBA signage; low William Hill ribbon window adjoining. Private capture output/opticians-front.png (filename predates correct subject identification).

sources.author: Google Street View
observations: Anchor Street: rendered Myers side, upper sash run, two side roof dormers, rear garage shutter, pipes and narrow pavement.

sources.author: Google Street View
observations: Myers shop window and black fascia wrap onto Anchor Street; cream rendered side with incised pilaster strips.

sources.author: Google / Airbus
observations: Roof plan for all three shops; map centre verified by right-click at pixel720,500. Roof parallax prevents treating all roof pixels as wall footprint controls.

uncertainties: Edges about +/-0.5m from screenshot reading; rear depths are map outlines, not surveyed.
Heights are single eaves/parapet estimates; roofs, gables and rooftop structures are omitted.
Tenants named for identification only and reflect the referenced capture dates.
